scripts.text:
BEGIN TRY
	UPDATE EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM
	SET [ISLATEST] = 0
		,[SCD_END_DATE] = (
			SELECT PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
			FROM EDS.DATE_DIM
			INNER JOIN (
				SELECT TOP 1 CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS INTEGER) MX_DT
				FROM D360.STG_EDS_DID_DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM
				) MX_DT_TBL ON DATESK = MX_DT
			)
	FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM tgt
	LEFT JOIN D360.STG_EDS_DID_DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM src 
	ON (
         tgt.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Bills Payment'
         AND src.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Bills Payment'
         AND CASE WHEN src.BILLER_ID IN ('ALVS') THEN src.BILLER_NAME ELSE src.BILLER_ID END = CASE WHEN tgt.BILLER_ID IN ('ALVS') THEN tgt.BILLER_NAME ELSE tgt.BILLER_ID END
	--AND src.BILLER_ID = tgt.BILLER_ID
       )
    OR (
         tgt.PAYMENT_TYPE <> 'Bills Payment'
         AND src.PAYMENT_TYPE <> 'Bills Payment'
         AND tgt.TXN_TYPE = src.TXN_TYPE
         AND tgt.SOURCE = src.SOURCE
       )
    OR 
        (
         tgt.PAYMENT_TYPE IS NULL
         AND src.PAYMENT_TYPE IS NULL
         AND tgt.TXN_TYPE = src.TXN_TYPE
         AND tgt.SOURCE = src.SOURCE
       )
	WHERE tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1
		AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', 
		CONCAT_WS(N'|', 
		src.[TXN_CATEGORY],
		src.[TXN_GROUP],
		src.[PAYMENT_TYPE],
		src.[TXN_DESCRIPTION],
		src.[TXN_EXCLUSION],
		src.[BILLER_NAME],
		src.[PROPRIETARY_TAG],
		src.[P2B_TAG],
		src.[EBK_BP],
		src.[MBK_BP],
		src.[D30_BP],
		src.[P2B_BP],
		src.[DEFAULT_FEE_BP],
		src.[GROSS_TXN_FEE],
		src.[NET_TXN_FEE])) 
		<> 
		HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', 
		tgt.[TXN_CATEGORY],
		tgt.[TXN_GROUP],
		tgt.[PAYMENT_TYPE],
		tgt.[TXN_DESCRIPTION],
		tgt.[TXN_EXCLUSION],
		tgt.[BILLER_NAME],
		tgt.[PROPRIETARY_TAG],
		tgt.[P2B_TAG],
		tgt.[EBK_BP],
		tgt.[MBK_BP],
		tgt.[D30_BP],
		tgt.[P2B_BP],
		tgt.[DEFAULT_FEE_BP],
		tgt.[GROSS_TXN_FEE],
		tgt.[NET_TXN_FEE]));

	INSERT INTO EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM (
		 [SOURCE]
		,[TXN_CATEGORY]
		,[TXN_GROUP]
		,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
		,[TXN_TYPE]
		,[TXN_DESCRIPTION]
		,[TXN_EXCLUSION]
		,[BILLER_ID]
		,[BILLER_NAME]
		,[PROPRIETARY_TAG]
		,[P2B_TAG]
		,[EBK_BP]
		,[MBK_BP]
		,[D30_BP]
		,[P2B_BP]
		,[DEFAULT_FEE_BP]
		,[GROSS_TXN_FEE]
		,[NET_TXN_FEE]
		,SCD_START_DATE
		,SCD_END_DATE
		,ISACTIVE
		,ISLATEST
		,[BNK_CODE] 
		,[SOURCE_CODE]
		,[FILE_NAME]
		,[INSERT_DTTM]
		)
	SELECT DISTINCT
		[SOURCE]
		,[TXN_CATEGORY]
		,[TXN_GROUP]
		,[PAYMENT_TYPE]
		,[TXN_TYPE]
		,[TXN_DESCRIPTION]
		,[TXN_EXCLUSION]
		,[BILLER_ID]
		,[BILLER_NAME]
		,[PROPRIETARY_TAG]
		,[P2B_TAG]
		,[EBK_BP]
		,[MBK_BP]
		,[D30_BP]
		,[P2B_BP]
		,[DEFAULT_FEE_BP]
		,[GROSS_TXN_FEE]
		,[NET_TXN_FEE]
		,CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8) AS DATE) AS [SCD_START_DATE]
		,CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) AS [SCD_END_DATE]
		,1 AS [ISACTIVE]
		,1 AS [ISLATEST]
		,LEFT(FILE_NAME, 5) AS [BNK_CODE]
		,'DID' AS [SOURCE_CODE]
		,[FILE_NAME]
		,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) AS INSERT_DTTM
	FROM D360.STG_EDS_DID_DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM src
	WHERE NOT EXISTS (
			SELECT 1
			FROM EDS.DIGITAL_BILLERS_DIM tgt
			WHERE((
					tgt.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Bills Payment'
					AND src.PAYMENT_TYPE = 'Bills Payment'
					         AND CASE WHEN src.BILLER_ID IN ('ALVS') THEN src.BILLER_NAME ELSE src.BILLER_ID END = CASE WHEN tgt.BILLER_ID IN ('ALVS') THEN tgt.BILLER_NAME ELSE tgt.BILLER_ID END
					--AND src.BILLER_ID = tgt.BILLER_ID
				)
				OR (
					tgt.PAYMENT_TYPE <> 'Bills Payment'
					AND src.PAYMENT_TYPE <> 'Bills Payment'
					AND tgt.TXN_TYPE = src.TXN_TYPE
					AND tgt.SOURCE = src.SOURCE
				)
				OR 
					(
					tgt.PAYMENT_TYPE IS NULL
					AND src.PAYMENT_TYPE IS NULL
					AND tgt.TXN_TYPE = src.TXN_TYPE
					AND tgt.SOURCE = src.SOURCE
				))
				AND HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', 
				src.[TXN_CATEGORY],
				src.[TXN_GROUP],
				src.[PAYMENT_TYPE],
				src.[TXN_DESCRIPTION],
				src.[TXN_EXCLUSION],
				src.[BILLER_NAME],
				src.[PROPRIETARY_TAG],
				src.[P2B_TAG],
				src.[EBK_BP],
				src.[MBK_BP],
				src.[D30_BP],
				src.[P2B_BP],
				src.[DEFAULT_FEE_BP],
				src.[GROSS_TXN_FEE],
				src.[NET_TXN_FEE])) 
				= 
				HASHBYTES('SHA2_256', CONCAT_WS(N'|', 
				tgt.[TXN_CATEGORY],
				tgt.[TXN_GROUP],
				tgt.[PAYMENT_TYPE],
				tgt.[TXN_DESCRIPTION],
				tgt.[TXN_EXCLUSION],
				tgt.[BILLER_NAME],
				tgt.[PROPRIETARY_TAG],
				tgt.[P2B_TAG],
				tgt.[EBK_BP],
				tgt.[MBK_BP],
				tgt.[D30_BP],
				tgt.[P2B_BP],
				tgt.[DEFAULT_FEE_BP],
				tgt.[GROSS_TXN_FEE],
				tgt.[NET_TXN_FEE]))
				AND tgt.[ISLATEST] = 1
			);
END TRY

BEGIN CATCH
	DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(2048) = ERROR_MESSAGE();

	THROW 51000
		,@msg
		,1;
END CATCH
